title: Choose which courses your school uses

handbook.what: Narrowing the full list of courses your school can teach down to the handful you actually intend to use, so that choosing a course for a class is a short list rather than a long one.
handbook.where: Step three of first-time setup, the grid of tickable course tiles under **Choose courses**.
how: Open step three of first-time setup.
Everything available to your school starts ticked.
Untick anything you do not plan to teach.
Tap **Continue** — the next step only offers the courses you left ticked.
handbook.note: This is a filter and nothing more. It does not change what your school has access to, and it takes nothing away from anyone. A school on a trial sees its one trial course here; a subscribed school sees the whole catalogue.
